hero.headline: The night, before it starts.
hero.support: Discover events, secure your ticket, and arrive with everything settled.
hero.imageAlt: Crowd under lights at a nightlife event

about.headline: The platform that makes the night clear.
about.body: {appNameDisplay} connects clubs and audiences in one experience: real events, unambiguous tickets, and an interface that feels the night without dressing it up as a flyer.
about.imageAlt: Lit stage during a live show

atmosphere.support: Clear tickets, real dates, and a schedule you can read in seconds — before the first drop hits.
atmosphere.imageAlt: Crowd with hands in the air at a night show

1.title: Create your account
1.body: Register once. After that, every night is one tap away.

2.title: Choose the night
2.body: Browse dates, clubs, and tickets with the information that matters.

3.title: Ticket ready
3.body: Buy, confirm, and arrive knowing your place is already set.

clarity.headline: Ticket, door, and schedule — no fine print.
clarity.support: What you need to decide and arrive, up front.

ticket.title: Clear tickets
ticket.body: Type, price, and availability in one place. No surprises in line.

secure.title: QR ready at the door
secure.body: Clear confirmation and a code ready when you arrive. Less friction at entry.

time.title: Dates you can scan fast
time.body: Times and clubs in view — while there’s still room.

pulse.headline: Built for the night that’s already moving.
pulse.body: {appNameDisplay} doesn’t invent the scene — it organizes it. Discover, choose, and secure your place without losing the mood.
pulse.imageAlt: Crowd hands raised in front of the stage

events.headline: The schedule isn’t open yet
events.support: When nights go live, they’ll live here. Create your account so you’re ready the day the first date drops.
events.previewAria: Live-night atmosphere — no published dates yet

closing.support: Create your account and come back when the full schedule opens.
